decisions.what: Added an internal defineClip() method and spriteSpritesheets map to AnimationManager
decisions.why: The spec requires AnimatedSprite instances built from spritesheet clip frames and clip switching by name, so clips must be registerable per spritesheet and each sprite must remember which spritesheet owns its clips.

decisions.what: Wired AnimationManager into CanvasEngine.init() and destroy() alongside SpriteManager
decisions.why: Spec required a getAnimationManager() accessor and cleanup of animated sprites during destroy() while preserving existing manager wiring.

decisions.what: In main.ts, wrapped the animation demo in its own try/catch and defined the walk clip before creating the animated sprite
decisions.why: The placeholder Unsplash texture is unlikely to decode as a real atlas, so the demo must degrade gracefully without blocking the rest of the engine boot; defining the clip is required before AnimationManager.createAnimatedSprite will succeed.

decisions.what: Mocked Assets.load and Spritesheet.prototype.parse via jest.spyOn in the tests
decisions.why: PixiJS 8 loads real GPU/WebGL resources by default; jsdom cannot host them, so the atlas parsing is stubbed to inject Texture.EMPTY frames while still exercising real AnimatedSprite instances.
